cases.prompt:
Summarize the following in exactly two sentences. Do not add information that is not present in the text.

Students may submit Lab 3 until 11:59 PM on October 2 without penalty. The original deadline was September 30. The extension applies to all sections and does not require students to contact their instructor. Lab 4 has not been extended and remains due October 7.

must_include_concepts: Lab 3 extended to October 2 at 11:59 PM

cases.prompt:
Write a concise technical summary in no more than 70 words.

The application currently sends every AI request directly to a specific model endpoint. This makes model replacement difficult because each application contains provider-specific code. The proposed architecture introduces a local gateway between applications and model providers. Applications send provider-independent requests to the gateway, while the gateway handles routing, authentication, model selection, and future fallback behavior. This allows model providers to change without requiring modifications to every application.

must_include_concepts: gateway handles routing or model selection
providers can change without modifying every application

cases.prompt:
Summarize the incident below for a technical project lead. Use no more than four bullet points.

At 08:12, monitoring detected elevated latency on the recommendation service. CPU usage remained normal, but database connection counts were close to their maximum. At 08:19, engineers discovered that a recently deployed worker was failing to release connections after completed jobs. The worker deployment was disabled at 08:26. Connection counts began falling immediately and latency returned to normal by 08:31. No data loss occurred. A code fix and regression test are required before the worker is re-enabled.

must_include_concepts: connection leak in newly deployed worker
